en: Whatever is in the heavens and whatever is on the earth exalts Allah, and He is the Exalted in Might, the Wise.
ar: سَبَّحَ لِلَّهِ مَا فِي ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَمَا فِي ٱلۡأَرۡضِۖ وَهُوَ ٱلۡعَزِيزُ ٱلۡحَكِيمُ

nb.en: O you who have believed, why do you say what you do not do?

tr: Sabbaha lillahi ma fee alssamawati wama fee alardi wahuwa alAAazeezu alhakeemu

en: And what can make you know what is the Striking Calamity?
ar: وَمَآ أَدۡرَىٰكَ مَا ٱلۡقَارِعَةُ

nb.en: What is the Striking Calamity?

tr: Wama adraka ma alqariAAatu

en: And they ask you, [O Muhammad], about Dhul-Qarnayn. Say, "I will recite to you about him a report."
ar: وَيَسۡـَٔلُونَكَ عَن ذِي ٱلۡقَرۡنَيۡنِۖ قُلۡ سَأَتۡلُواْ عَلَيۡكُم مِّنۡهُ ذِكۡرًا

nb.en: And as for the wall, it belonged to two orphan boys in the city, and there was beneath it a treasure for them, and their father had been righteous. So your Lord intended that they reach maturity and extract their treasure, as a mercy from your Lord. And I did it not of my own accord. That is the interpretation of that about which you could not have patience."

tr: Wayasaloonaka AAan thee alqarnayni qul saatloo AAalaykum minhu thikran

en: They will be reclining on thrones lined up, and We will marry them to fair women with large, [beautiful] eyes.
ar: مُتَّكِـِٔينَ عَلَىٰ سُرُرٖ مَّصۡفُوفَةٖۖ وَزَوَّجۡنَٰهُم بِحُورٍ عِينٖ

nb.en: [They will be told], "Eat and drink in satisfaction for what you used to do."

tr: Muttakieena AAala sururin masfoofatin wazawwajnahum bihoorin AAeenin

en: And what can make you know what is [breaking through] the difficult pass?
ar: وَمَآ أَدۡرَىٰكَ مَا ٱلۡعَقَبَةُ

nb.en: But he has not broken through the difficult pass.

tr: Wama adraka ma alAAaqabatu

en: And take for yourselves palaces and fortresses that you might abide eternally?
ar: وَتَتَّخِذُونَ مَصَانِعَ لَعَلَّكُمۡ تَخۡلُدُونَ

nb.en: Do you construct on every elevation a sign, amusing yourselves,

tr: Watattakhithoona masaniAAa laAAallakum takhludoona

en: And they had thought, as you thought, that Allah would never send anyone [as a messenger].
ar: وَأَنَّهُمۡ ظَنُّواْ كَمَا ظَنَنتُمۡ أَن لَّن يَبۡعَثَ ٱللَّهُ أَحَدٗا

nb.en: And there were men from mankind who sought refuge in men from the jinn, so they [only] increased them in burden.

tr: Waannahum thannoo kama thanantum an lan yabAAatha Allahu ahadan

en: And with the truth We have sent the Qur'an down, and with the truth it has descended. And We have not sent you, [O Muhammad], except as a bringer of good tidings and a warner.
ar: وَبِٱلۡحَقِّ أَنزَلۡنَٰهُ وَبِٱلۡحَقِّ نَزَلَۗ وَمَآ أَرۡسَلۡنَٰكَ إِلَّا مُبَشِّرٗا وَنَذِيرٗا

nb.en: And We said after Pharaoh to the Children of Israel, "Dwell in the land, and when there comes the promise of the Hereafter, We will bring you forth in [one] gathering."

tr: Wabialhaqqi anzalnahu wabialhaqqi nazala wama arsalnaka illa mubashshiran wanatheeran

en: For those it is expected that Allah will pardon them, and Allah is ever Pardoning and Forgiving.
ar: فَأُوْلَـٰٓئِكَ عَسَى ٱللَّهُ أَن يَعۡفُوَ عَنۡهُمۡۚ وَكَانَ ٱللَّهُ عَفُوًّا غَفُورٗا

nb.en: Except for the oppressed among men, women and children who cannot devise a plan nor are they directed to a way -

tr: Faolaika AAasa Allahu an yaAAfuwa AAanhum wakana Allahu AAafuwwan ghafooran

en: O people, an example is presented, so listen to it. Indeed, those you invoke besides Allah will never create [as much as] a fly, even if they gathered together for that purpose. And if the fly should steal away from them a [tiny] thing, they could not recover it from him. Weak are the pursuer and pursued.
ar: يَـٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلنَّاسُ ضُرِبَ مَثَلٞ فَٱسۡتَمِعُواْ لَهُۥٓۚ إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ تَدۡعُونَ مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ لَن يَخۡلُقُواْ ذُبَابٗا وَلَوِ ٱجۡتَمَعُواْ لَهُۥۖ وَإِن يَسۡلُبۡهُمُ ٱلذُّبَابُ شَيۡـٔٗا لَّا يَسۡتَنقِذُوهُ مِنۡهُۚ ضَعُفَ ٱلطَّالِبُ وَٱلۡمَطۡلُوبُ

nb.en: And when Our verses are recited to them as clear evidences, you recognize in the faces of those who disbelieve disapproval. They are almost on the verge of assaulting those who recite to them Our verses. Say, "Then shall I inform you of [what is] worse than that? [It is] the Fire which Allah has promised those who disbelieve, and wretched is the destination."

tr: Ya ayyuha alnnasu duriba mathalun faistamiAAoo lahu inna allatheena tadAAoona min dooni Allahi lan yakhluqoo thubaban walawi ijtamaAAoo lahu wain yaslubuhumu alththubabu shayan la yastanqithoohu minhu daAAufa alttalibu waalmatloobu

en: The angels and the Spirit descend therein by permission of their Lord for every matter.
ar: تَنَزَّلُ ٱلۡمَلَـٰٓئِكَةُ وَٱلرُّوحُ فِيهَا بِإِذۡنِ رَبِّهِم مِّن كُلِّ أَمۡرٖ

nb.en: The Night of Decree is better than a thousand months.

tr: Tanazzalu almalaikatu waalrroohu feeha biithni rabbihim min kulli amrin

en: And they say, "O you upon whom the message has been sent down, indeed you are mad.
ar: وَقَالُواْ يَـٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِي نُزِّلَ عَلَيۡهِ ٱلذِّكۡرُ إِنَّكَ لَمَجۡنُونٞ

nb.en: No nation will precede its term, nor will they remain thereafter.

tr: Waqaloo ya ayyuha allathee nuzzila AAalayhi alththikru innaka lamajnoonun

en: So his Lord responded to him and averted from him their plan. Indeed, He is the Hearing, the Knowing.
ar: فَٱسۡتَجَابَ لَهُۥ رَبُّهُۥ فَصَرَفَ عَنۡهُ كَيۡدَهُنَّۚ إِنَّهُۥ هُوَ ٱلسَّمِيعُ ٱلۡعَلِيمُ

nb.en: He said, "My Lord, prison is more to my liking than that to which they invite me. And if You do not avert from me their plan, I might incline toward them and [thus] be of the ignorant."

tr: Faistajaba lahu rabbuhu fasarafa AAanhu kaydahunna innahu huwa alssameeAAu alAAaleemu

en: Who has fed them, [saving them] from hunger and made them safe, [saving them] from fear.
ar: ٱلَّذِيٓ أَطۡعَمَهُم مِّن جُوعٖ وَءَامَنَهُم مِّنۡ خَوۡفِۭ

nb.en: Let them worship the Lord of this House,

tr: Allathee atAAamahum min jooAAin waamanahum min khawfin

en: It is not [befitting] for Allah to take a son; exalted is He! When He decrees an affair, He only says to it, "Be," and it is.
ar: مَا كَانَ لِلَّهِ أَن يَتَّخِذَ مِن وَلَدٖۖ سُبۡحَٰنَهُۥٓۚ إِذَا قَضَىٰٓ أَمۡرٗا فَإِنَّمَا يَقُولُ لَهُۥ كُن فَيَكُونُ

nb.en: That is Jesus, the son of Mary - the word of truth about which they are in dispute.

tr: Ma kana lillahi an yattakhitha min waladin subhanahu itha qada amran fainnama yaqoolu lahu kun fayakoonu

en: And [We destroyed] the people of Noah before; indeed, they were a people defiantly disobedient.
ar: وَقَوۡمَ نُوحٖ مِّن قَبۡلُۖ إِنَّهُمۡ كَانُواْ قَوۡمٗا فَٰسِقِينَ

nb.en: And they were unable to arise, nor could they defend themselves.

tr: Waqawma noohin min qablu innahum kanoo qawman fasiqeena

en: O you who have believed, do not prohibit the good things which Allah has made lawful to you and do not transgress. Indeed, Allah does not like transgressors.
ar: يَـٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ لَا تُحَرِّمُواْ طَيِّبَٰتِ مَآ أَحَلَّ ٱللَّهُ لَكُمۡ وَلَا تَعۡتَدُوٓاْۚ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ لَا يُحِبُّ ٱلۡمُعۡتَدِينَ

nb.en: But those who disbelieved and denied Our signs - they are the companions of Hellfire.

tr: Ya ayyuha allatheena amanoo la tuharrimoo tayyibati ma ahalla Allahu lakum wala taAAtadoo inna Allaha la yuhibbu almuAAtadeena

en: O mankind, indeed you are laboring toward your Lord with [great] exertion and will meet it.
ar: يَـٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلۡإِنسَٰنُ إِنَّكَ كَادِحٌ إِلَىٰ رَبِّكَ كَدۡحٗا فَمُلَٰقِيهِ

nb.en: And has responded to its Lord and was obligated [to do so] -

tr: Ya ayyuha alinsanu innaka kadihun ila rabbika kadhan famulaqeehi

en: And O my people, ask forgiveness of your Lord and then repent to Him. He will send [rain from] the sky upon you in showers and increase you in strength [added] to your strength. And do not turn away, [being] criminals."
ar: وَيَٰقَوۡمِ ٱسۡتَغۡفِرُواْ رَبَّكُمۡ ثُمَّ تُوبُوٓاْ إِلَيۡهِ يُرۡسِلِ ٱلسَّمَآءَ عَلَيۡكُم مِّدۡرَارٗا وَيَزِدۡكُمۡ قُوَّةً إِلَىٰ قُوَّتِكُمۡ وَلَا تَتَوَلَّوۡاْ مُجۡرِمِينَ

nb.en: O my people, I do not ask you for it any reward. My reward is only from the one who created me. Then will you not reason?

tr: Waya qawmi istaghfiroo rabbakum thumma tooboo ilayhi yursili alssamaa AAalaykum midraran wayazidkum quwwatan ila quwwatikum wala tatawallaw mujrimeena

en: Then you will surely see it with the eye of certainty.
ar: ثُمَّ لَتَرَوُنَّهَا عَيۡنَ ٱلۡيَقِينِ

nb.en: You will surely see the Hellfire.

tr: Thumma latarawunnaha AAayna alyaqeeni

en: Indeed, your Lord is most knowing of who has gone astray from His way, and He is most knowing of the [rightly] guided.
ar: إِنَّ رَبَّكَ هُوَ أَعۡلَمُ بِمَن ضَلَّ عَن سَبِيلِهِۦ وَهُوَ أَعۡلَمُ بِٱلۡمُهۡتَدِينَ

nb.en: Which of you is the afflicted [by a devil].

tr: Inna rabbaka huwa aAAlamu biman dalla AAan sabeelihi wahuwa aAAlamu bialmuhtadeena

en: That Day, you will be exhibited [for judgement]; not hidden among you is anything concealed.
ar: يَوۡمَئِذٖ تُعۡرَضُونَ لَا تَخۡفَىٰ مِنكُمۡ خَافِيَةٞ

nb.en: And the angels are at its edges. And there will bear the Throne of your Lord above them, that Day, eight [of them].

tr: Yawmaithin tuAAradoona la takhfa minkum khafiyatun

en: And there were in the city nine family heads causing corruption in the land and not amending [its affairs].
ar: وَكَانَ فِي ٱلۡمَدِينَةِ تِسۡعَةُ رَهۡطٖ يُفۡسِدُونَ فِي ٱلۡأَرۡضِ وَلَا يُصۡلِحُونَ

nb.en: They said, "We consider you a bad omen, you and those with you." He said, "Your omen is with Allah. Rather, you are a people being tested."

tr: Wakana fee almadeenati tisAAatu rahtin yufsidoona fee alardi wala yuslihoona

en: But what would make you perceive, [O Muhammad], that perhaps he might be purified
ar: وَمَا يُدۡرِيكَ لَعَلَّهُۥ يَزَّكَّىٰٓ

nb.en: Because there came to him the blind man, [interrupting].

tr: Wama yudreeka laAAallahu yazzakka

en: Never will their wealth or their children avail them against Allah at all. Those are the companions of the Fire; they will abide therein eternally
ar: لَّن تُغۡنِيَ عَنۡهُمۡ أَمۡوَٰلُهُمۡ وَلَآ أَوۡلَٰدُهُم مِّنَ ٱللَّهِ شَيۡـًٔاۚ أُوْلَـٰٓئِكَ أَصۡحَٰبُ ٱلنَّارِۖ هُمۡ فِيهَا خَٰلِدُونَ

nb.en: They took their [false] oaths as a cover, so they averted [people] from the way of Allah, and for them is a humiliating punishment.

tr: Lan tughniya AAanhum amwaluhum wala awladuhum mina Allahi shayan olaika ashabu alnnari hum feeha khalidoona

en: Your Lord has not taken leave of you, [O Muhammad], nor has He detested [you].
ar: مَا وَدَّعَكَ رَبُّكَ وَمَا قَلَىٰ

nb.en: And [by] the night when it covers with darkness,

tr: Ma waddaAAaka rabbuka wama qala

en: The Day they will emerge from the graves rapidly as if they were, toward an erected idol, hastening.
ar: يَوۡمَ يَخۡرُجُونَ مِنَ ٱلۡأَجۡدَاثِ سِرَاعٗا كَأَنَّهُمۡ إِلَىٰ نُصُبٖ يُوفِضُونَ

nb.en: So leave them to converse vainly and amuse themselves until they meet their Day which they are promised -

tr: Yawma yakhrujoona mina alajdathi siraAAan kaannahum ila nusubin yoofidoona

en: That is because you took the verses of Allah in ridicule, and worldly life deluded you." So that Day they will not be removed from it, nor will they be asked to appease [Allah].
ar: ذَٰلِكُم بِأَنَّكُمُ ٱتَّخَذۡتُمۡ ءَايَٰتِ ٱللَّهِ هُزُوٗا وَغَرَّتۡكُمُ ٱلۡحَيَوٰةُ ٱلدُّنۡيَاۚ فَٱلۡيَوۡمَ لَا يُخۡرَجُونَ مِنۡهَا وَلَا هُمۡ يُسۡتَعۡتَبُونَ

nb.en: And it will be said, "Today We will forget you as you forgot the meeting of this Day of yours, and your refuge is the Fire, and for you there are no helpers.

tr: Thalikum biannakumu ittakhathtum ayati Allahi huzuwan wagharratkumu alhayatu alddunya faalyawma la yukhrajoona minha wala hum yustaAAtaboona

en: It is He who created you, and among you is the disbeliever, and among you is the believer. And Allah, of what you do, is Seeing.
ar: هُوَ ٱلَّذِي خَلَقَكُمۡ فَمِنكُمۡ كَافِرٞ وَمِنكُم مُّؤۡمِنٞۚ وَٱللَّهُ بِمَا تَعۡمَلُونَ بَصِيرٌ

nb.en: Whatever is in the heavens and whatever is on the earth is exalting Allah. To Him belongs dominion, and to Him belongs [all] praise, and He is over all things competent.

tr: Huwa allathee khalaqakum faminkum kafirun waminkum muminun waAllahu bima taAAmaloona baseerun

en: Say, "Have you considered: if the Qur'an was from Allah, and you disbelieved in it while a witness from the Children of Israel has testified to something similar and believed while you were arrogant...?" Indeed, Allah does not guide the wrongdoing people.
ar: قُلۡ أَرَءَيۡتُمۡ إِن كَانَ مِنۡ عِندِ ٱللَّهِ وَكَفَرۡتُم بِهِۦ وَشَهِدَ شَاهِدٞ مِّنۢ بَنِيٓ إِسۡرَـٰٓءِيلَ عَلَىٰ مِثۡلِهِۦ فَـَٔامَنَ وَٱسۡتَكۡبَرۡتُمۡۚ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ لَا يَهۡدِي ٱلۡقَوۡمَ ٱلظَّـٰلِمِينَ

nb.en: Say, "I am not something original among the messengers, nor do I know what will be done with me or with you. I only follow that which is revealed to me, and I am not but a clear warner."

tr: Qul araaytum in kana min AAindi Allahi wakafartum bihi washahida shahidun min banee israeela AAala mithlihi faamana waistakbartum inna Allaha la yahdee alqawma alththalimeena
